think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range. 2) Check documentation for sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a different mode (disable/auto/override) rather than just scaling behavior. 3) Determine whether such a value breaks the natural numeric ordering by changing semantics. 4) If yes, mark as special and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
